meta.source: elioo studio redesign spec 2026-11-17 (ink editorial, stacked product cards); product colours copied from the Medioo, Bolo, Finioo and IntelliDrugs design systems

color.note: One theme on purpose: the ink. elioo has no hue of its own; colour belongs to the products. Product tokens are exact copies from each product's own design system.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere on eliooo.org. Warm near-black, never pure #000.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Quiet blocks on ground: blog post cards, code blocks, the founder panel, the video placeholder when no product owns it.

tokens.name: raised-2
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of raised blocks; inline code background.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers only: section rules, list rows, footer rule. Never the only boundary of a control (1.37:1).

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Boundary of interactive controls on ground and raised: ghost buttons, inputs, the menu button (3.75:1 on ground, 3.45:1 on raised).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headlines, the primary button fill, the focus ring. 17.1:1 on ground, 15.8:1 on raised.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, descriptions, nav links at rest, the dim words of the statement reveal once lit. 9.0:1 on ground, 8.3:1 on raised.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Meta only: dates, reading time, footer small print, eyebrow labels. 5.6:1 on ground, 5.1:1 on raised; not for paragraphs.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and arrows on an ink fill (the primary button). 17.1:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, 3px offset, on every focusable element on ground. Inside a product card use that product's ink token instead.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Full-screen mobile menu overlay on top of the page.

tokens.name: medioo-ground
tokens.usage: Medioo card and page header ground (Medioo `bg`, light). Warm paper.

tokens.name: medioo-ink
tokens.usage: Text on medioo-ground (Medioo `text`). 12.9:1.

tokens.name: medioo-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on medioo-ground (Medioo `text-muted`). 6.2:1.

tokens.name: medioo-primary
tokens.usage: Medioo's Try it button fill (Medioo `primary`), text in medioo-on-primary. As text on medioo-ground only at 18px+ (4.8:1).

tokens.name: medioo-on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on medioo-primary (5.2:1).

tokens.name: medioo-green
tokens.usage: Medioo's brand green: the 'oo' of its wordmark and illustration accents only. Never text, never status.

tokens.name: bolo-sky-high
tokens.usage: Top of Bolo's dusk sky; the ground all Bolo card text sits on (Bolo `scene-sky-high`).

tokens.name: bolo-sky-mid
tokens.usage: Violet middle step of Bolo's sky (Bolo `scene-sky-mid`). Text may sit here (7.9:1 with bolo-ink).

tokens.name: bolo-sky-low
tokens.usage: Dusty-rose horizon (Bolo `scene-sky-low`). Never put text over it (2.6:1).

tokens.name: bolo-night
tokens.usage: Bolo page body ground below the header (Bolo `canvas`, Night).

tokens.name: bolo-sun
tokens.usage: Bolo's mustard sun: its Try it button fill and the sun disc in the scene (Bolo `sun`).

tokens.name: bolo-on-sun
tokens.usage: Label on bolo-sun (9.5:1).

tokens.name: bolo-ink
tokens.usage: Text on bolo-sky-high and bolo-night (Bolo `on-scene`). 14.6:1 on sky-high.

tokens.name: bolo-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bolo-sky-high and bolo-night (Bolo `ink-secondary`, Night).

tokens.name: finioo-ground
tokens.usage: Finioo card and page header ground (Finioo `page`, light).

tokens.name: finioo-ink
tokens.usage: Text on finioo-ground (Finioo `fg`). 15.4:1.

tokens.name: finioo-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on finioo-ground (Finioo `fg-2`). 4.9:1.

tokens.name: finioo-ember
tokens.usage: Finioo's one action colour, as a fill only (status pill, button). Never as text or a thin line: 2.4:1 on finioo-ground.

tokens.name: finioo-on-ember
tokens.usage: Label on finioo-ember (7.0:1).

tokens.name: finioo-forest
tokens.usage: Finioo brand forest: the fox's world in illustrations and the video placeholder (Finioo `brand-forest`).

tokens.name: drugs-ground
tokens.usage: IntelliDrugs card and page header ground (IntelliDrugs `--bg`).

tokens.name: drugs-ink
tokens.usage: Text on drugs-ground (IntelliDrugs `--fg`). 16.5:1.

tokens.name: drugs-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on drugs-ground (IntelliDrugs `--fg-2`). 7.8:1.

tokens.name: drugs-accent
tokens.usage: IntelliDrugs cobalt: Try it button fill and the wordmark's full stop (IntelliDrugs `--accent`). 6.0:1 on drugs-ground.

tokens.name: drugs-on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on drugs-accent.

type.note: Instrument Sans for everything, with the width axis pulled in for display sizes. Instrument Serif italic only for the ONE accent word in a large headline. Mono only for code in blog posts.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero headline only. Fluid: clamp(56px, 10vw, 128px).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Product page names, the contact call to action, section openers. Fluid: clamp(44px, 7vw, 88px).

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Product names on cards, blog post titles. Fluid: clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px).

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Section headings inside product pages and posts.

styles.name: title-3
styles.sample: Code decides, the model words it
styles.usage: Sub-headings, blog card titles, hard-problem titles.

styles.name: accent
styles.usage: The single italic word inside a display headline. Inherits the headline's size; one per headline, never in body text.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: I build AI products for Bangladesh, from the first sketch to production, on my own.
styles.usage: The word-by-word reveal statement on home. Fluid: clamp(28px, 4.2vw, 48px).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A family of AI products, designed, built and shipped by one person.
styles.usage: Hero lede, product pitch lines, the first paragraph of a post. ink-2.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Medioo keeps a family's medical papers and says what is written on them in plain Bangla.
styles.usage: Default reading text: card descriptions, product page copy, blog prose. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Stack: Spring Boot, Next.js, Postgres on Supabase.
styles.usage: Dense lists, footer columns, captions under media.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and pill labels. Sentence case, verb first.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and category labels, set in uppercase. ink-3 on ground; the product's muted ink inside a card.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, reading time, status text. ink-3.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The big card number (01–04) on each product card, at 12% of the card's ink. Fluid: clamp(96px, 14vw, 200px).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code in blog posts only.

spacing.note: A 4px base that opens up fast: editorial pages breathe in big steps.

tokens.name: s-1
tokens.usage: Status dot to its word, tight icon gaps.

tokens.name: s-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row on mobile, between tags.

tokens.name: s-3
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to heading.

tokens.name: s-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page side gutter (phones); heading to paragraph.

tokens.name: s-5
tokens.usage: Paragraph groups, card inner gaps, button rows.

tokens.name: s-6
tokens.usage: Page side gutter from 768px; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: s-7
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; between a heading block and its content.

tokens.name: s-8
tokens.usage: Page side gutter from 1280px; between sub-sections.

tokens.name: s-9
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones.

tokens.name: s-10
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: stack-peek
tokens.usage: How much of each covered product card stays visible above the next one when stacked.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page frame.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Max width of reading text (blog posts, product page copy).

radius.note: Square type, soft containers: big radii on the product cards, pills for anything you press.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, small thumbnails, tags.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Video slots and images inside cards, blog cards, code blocks.

tokens.name: r-lg
tokens.usage: Product cards and product page headers.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, status labels, the menu button.

shadow.note: Depth only where the stack needs it.

tokens.name: shadow-stack
tokens.usage: Top edge of a product card sliding over the previous one.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Everything else. Separation comes from tone and space, not shadows.

duration.note: Motion is slow to start and quick to settle. Under prefers-reduced-motion everything is instant.

tokens.name: d-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback on buttons and links.

tokens.name: d-base
tokens.usage: Nav bar compacting, menu open, video fade-in.

tokens.name: d-slow
tokens.usage: Section headings rising into place on first view.

tokens.name: d-count
tokens.usage: Count-up numbers from 0 to their value.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything entering or settling: reveals, menu, count-up.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Scroll-scrubbed values (card scale and dim in the stack).
